widget_mechanic: When a plus-chip filter is set (e.g. '3+ bedrooms'), results include all N ≥ 3. To require EXACTLY N, agent must locate and enable the 'use exact match' toggle — usually below the plus-chip row or inside an advanced filters panel.

source_inspiration.instruction: Find a Single-Family House for Rent in Houston, TX with 1 bed.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: The agent chose to open the first visible listing (“Preserve at Woodridge”) without verifying it is located in Houston, TX, violating the task’s hard city constraint.
